categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Bojun Industrial Technology Co., Ltd primarily operates in the automotive precision parts and precision molds manufacturing sector. Its main business includes R&D, design, production, and sales of automotive precision stamped parts, injection molded components, and modular body parts for vehicle manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers. The company also engages in customized mold sales and automotive body modular assemblies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including stamping, laser welding, injection molding, hot forming, laser cutting, integrated die casting, and assembly. It has proprietary core technologies in stamping, welding, and embedded injection molding, supported by a strong mold development capability with various patented technologies. The production process is highly automated and integrates multiple key processes to ensure precision and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international automotive manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers such as Li Auto, Geely, BYD, Ford, Changan, Great Wall, Tesla, Volkswagen, and others. The company serves primarily the automotive industry, supplying precision parts for steering systems, powertrains, door systems, sunroofs, electronic systems, and other vehicle components. It also exports products to markets in North America, Europe, South America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Jiangsu (Kunshan, Changzhou), Chongqing, Chengdu, Hebei, Ningbo, and other key automotive clusters including the Yangtze River Delta, Southwest China, and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei regions. It also serves international markets through its global customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bojun Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying precision automotive components and molds to Tier 1 suppliers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). It does not engage in raw material extraction or final vehicle assembly but plays a critical role in parts production and module assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to enhance its technological capabilities, focusing on lightweight materials, automation, and intelligent manufacturing processes. Key R&D projects include high-precision injection mold ejection devices, automated riveting production lines, and advanced stamping and hot forming technologies for new energy vehicle components. It also pursues platform-based product development and collaborates with academic institutions to accelerate innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of automotive precision stamped parts, injection molded components, and customized molds. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with contracts specifying product types, quantities, and prices. It also earns revenue from modular body assemblies and other automotive component sales, with a majority of sales conducted domestically and a portion exported internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a fragmented but competitive automotive parts industry dominated by large multinational suppliers and strong domestic players. Bojun Technology has established a competitive position through its technological innovation, quality certifications (IATF16949), and strategic partnerships with leading OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. It is recognized as a key player in precision parts and molds within China's automotive supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.6 billion, representing an 87% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 308.5 million, up 108%. Total assets grew 60% to nearly RMB 5 billion. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanding production capacity, new customer acquisitions, and increased market demand, particularly in the new energy vehicle segment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bojun Technology differentiates itself through its advanced manufacturing technologies, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive quality control systems. It offers high-performance, specialized precision parts and molds tailored to customer specifications, supporting lightweight and intelligent automotive trends. The company’s integrated production lines and rapid response capabilities provide customers with efficient, reliable supply and technical support, enhancing its competitive advantage.
